text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a day out in town with Daiwa Scarlet, I walk her back to the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Phew… That was wonderful! It's nice taking things easy once in a while! ♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: And I'm sure it was a nice change of pace for you too, right? I mean, with me around, there's no way you couldn't have fun.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …You did have fun, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: O-oh, gosh! Just look how dark it's gotten!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …You know, now that I think about it, coming back this late probably isn't a good look for a model student.
choice_data_list: Just think of it as part of training!
Is it really that big of a deal?
Is it really that big of a deal?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: What are you saying? There's no way that excuses it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: But, if I start training now, then it won't just be an excuse, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …I meant that as a joke, but now I'm itching to get on the track.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: All right! That excursion was just a warm-up for the real training! Time to stretch my legs!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: And you're coming with me, obviously!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet spends the whole training session with a huge grin.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Of course it is! If people saw us coming back together, they might think we… went somewhere tog—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Urgh, never mind! The point is, yes, it's a problem! It could harm my reputation!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Well, I mean… it's not like I have an issue with going off campus with you…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I just don't want people getting the wrong idea, thinking we're chummy or anything.
choice_data_list: Just pretend I dragged you out for a break.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hehe, you couldn't "drag" me anywhere if you tried. Besides, blaming you makes you sound bad.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You might end up being removed as my trainer, and… I don't want that.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: But I know you're just worrying over my reputation, so… I guess what I mean is…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Something seems to have put her in a good mood.
